4.en: Applies the [Poison] effect. [Poison] - Increases Core Attack, Basic Skill, and Ultimate Skill damage by 20%. - Increases Attack and Defense by 1% every 1 second(s) (stacking up to 30 times). - Duration: Permanent

8.en: The [Poison] effect is enhanced to the [Blue Poison] effect. [Blue Poison] - Increases Defense Penetration by 20%. - Increases Core Attack, Basic Skill, and Ultimate Skill damage by 30%. - Increases Attack and Defense by 2.5% every 1 second(s) (stacks up to 30 times). - Duration: Permanent When equipped by [Sung Jinwoo] or a [Striker] class hunter, their damage dealt increases by 50%. [Poison] effect cannot be activated. Increases allies' damage dealt by 30% in [Team Fight] Mode (stacks up to 2 times).

4.en: The [Blazing Annihilation] effect is applied. [Blazing Annihilation] - Increases the user's Attack and Defense by 20%. - A successful Overload increases the user's Burst damage by 20% (stacking up to 3 times). - Duration: Permanent

8.en: The [Blazing Annihilation] effect is enhanced to the [Cataclysmic Blaze] effect. [Cataclysmic Blaze] - Increases the user's Attack and Defense by 50%. - A successful Overload increases the user's Burst damage by 20% (stacking up to 5 times). - Duration: Permanent When an Elemental Buster class hunter equips this, it increases their Overload damage dealt by 50%. [Blazing Annihilation] cannot be activated. Increases allies' Elemental Weakness damage by 30% in [Team Fight] Mode (stacks up to 2 times).

4.en: Applies the [Arrogance] effect. [Arrogance] - Increases the damage of skills with the [Break] effect by 30%. - When an attack that deals Break damage hits, the user and their team members' Critical Hit damage increases by 20%. - Duration: 40 second(s)

8.en: The user's [Break] effectiveness increases by 30%. [Arrogance] is enhanced to [Glorious Arrogance]. [Glorious Arrogance] - Increases the damage of skills with the [Break] effect by 50%. - When an attack that deals Break damage hits, the user and the team members' Critical Hit damage increases by 35%. - Duration: 40 second(s) When [Sung Jinwoo] or a [Breaker] class hunter equips this, it increases their Critical Hit damage by 40%. When [Sung Jinwoo] or a [Breaker] class hunter uses their Support Skill or Ultimate Skill, the user and their team members' Critical Hit Rate increases by 15%. - Duration: 60 second(s) [Arrogance] effect cannot be activated. Increases allies' Critical Hit damage dealt by 15% in [Team Fight] Mode (stacks up to 2 times).

notes: Texte EN du wiki Fandom (CC BY-SA), non vérifié en jeu ; FR à traduire depuis le jeu. Nom copié tel quel du wiki (orthographe source).

4.en: The [Fortification] effect is applied when a Basic Skill or Ultimate Skill hits. [Fortification] - Increases the user and the team members' Elemental Weakness damage by 15%. - Duration: 45 second(s) When tagging out or using a Support Skill or Ultimate Skill, the [Brilliant Light] effect is applied. [Brilliant Light] - Increases the user and the team members' damage dealt by 10%. - Duration: 20 second(s)

8.en: The user recovers 10% of their MP when tagging out or using their Ultimate Skill (Cooldown: 20 second(s)). The [Fortification] effect is enhanced to become the [Iron Body] effect. The [Brilliant Light] effect is enhanced to become the [Glory] effect. [Iron Body] - Increases the user and the team members' Elemental Weakness damage by 25%. - Duration: 45 second(s) [Glory] - Increases the user and the team members' damage dealt by 20%. - Duration: 20 second(s) When [Sung Jinwoo] or a [Supporter] class hunter equips this, it increases the user and team members' Core Attack, Basic Skill, and Ultimate Skill damage by 30% and increases the user and the team members' Attack, Defense, and HP by 15%. When [Sung Jinwoo] or a [Supporter] class hunter uses their Support Skill or Ultimate Skill, they recover 2% of their HP every 1 second(s) (Cooldown: 30 second(s)). - Duration: 6 second(s) [Fortification] and [Brilliant Light] cannot be activated. Increases allies' Attack, Defense, and HP by 15% in [Team Fight] Mode (stacks up to 2 times).

4.en: The [Obession] effect is applied. [Obession] ・Increases the user and the team members' Overload damage by 15% ・Increases Basic Skill and Ultimate Skill damage by 25% when successfully inflicting Overload damage (Cooldown: 20 second(s)). ・Duration: 20 second(s)

8.en: The [Obession] effect is enhanced to become the [Burning Obession] effect. [Burning Obession] ・Increases the user and the team members' Overload damage by 30% ・Increases Core Attack, Basic Skill, and Ultimate Skill damage by 40% when successfully inflicting Overload damage (Cooldown: 20 second(s)) ・Duration: 20 second(s) When [Sung Jinwoo] or an [Elemental Stacker] class hunter equips this, it increases their Overload damage by 50% and the user and the team members' Elemental Weakness damage by 20% The [Obession] effect cannot be activated Increases allies' Overload damage by 15% in [Team Fight] Mode (stacks up to 2 times).

2.en: Using this skill grants the Infamy effect. ・Excludes Support Skills [Infamy] ・Increases Basic Skill damage by 1.5% (stacking up to 20 times). ・Increases the user's damage taken by 1% (stacking up to 20 times) ・Duration: Permanent

4.en: Enhances the [Infamy] effect to Ehnahced Infamy. [Enhanced Infamy] ・Increases the user's Basic Skill damage by 2.5% (stacking up to 20%) ・Increases the user's damage taken by 1% (stacking up to 20 times) ・Duration: Permanent ・When the user uses their Basic Skill, they recover 5% of their MP (Cooldown: 30 second(s)). ・Unable to activate the Infamy effect.

8.en: In [Team Fight] mode, the user's damage dealt increases by 40%. When the [Enhanced Infamy] effect has stacked 10 times, it becomes the [Chaotic Infamy] effect. [Chaotic Infamy] ・Increases the user's Basic Skill and Ultimate Skill damage by 100%. ・Duration: Permanent ・Removes the Damage Taken Increase effect on the user. ・The user regians 5% of their MP when using their Basic Skill (Cooldown: 30 second(s)) ・The user becomes unable to activate the [Infamy] and [Enhanced Infamy] effects.

2.en: When an attack that deals [Break] damage hits, it triggers the [Desire] effect. [Desire] ・Increases the user's elemental damage by 0.5% (stacking up to 20 times). (Cooldown: 1.5 second(s)). ・Duration: Permanent

4.en: When the [Desire] effect has stacked 20 times, it becomes the [Enhanced Desire] effect. [Enhanced Desire] ・Increases the damage of the user's skill with the [Break] effect by 30%. ・Increases the user's and team members' elemental damage by 20% ・Duration: Permanent ・The user becomes unable to activate the [Desire] effect.

8.en: Attacking enemies that are at an elemental weakness increases the user's [Break] effectiveness by 30% The [Enhanced Desire] effect becomes the [Chaotic Desire] effect [Chaotic Desire] ・Increases the damage of the user's skill with the [Break] effect by 50%. ・The user and team members' elemental damage increases by 40% ・Duration: Permanent ・The user becomes unable to activate the [Desire] and [Enhanced Desire] effects.

2.en: When the user uses their Ultimate Skill, it grants the [Wish] effect to both them user and their team members. ・Increases Attack by 8%. (Cooldown: 25 second(s)). ・Duration: 10 second(s)

4.en: The [Wish] effect becomes the [Enhanced Wish] effect. [Enhanced Wish] ・Triggers when the user uses their Ultimate Skill or Support Skill. ・Increases the user's Attack and Defense by 10% ・Restores 0.2% of the user's HP every 1 second(s). (Cooldown: 25 second(s)) ・Duration: 10 second(s) ・The user becomes unable to activate the [Wish] effect.

8.en: The skill's MP Consumption Rate increases by 20% but the cooldown of the user's Basic Skill decreases by 10% The [Enhanced Wish] effect becomes the [Chaotic Wish] effect. [Chaotic Wish] ・Activates when the user uses their Ultimate Skill, Support Skill, or Core Attack. ・Increases Attack, Defense, and HP by 15% ・Restores 0.2% of the user's HP every 1 second(s). (Cooldown: 25 second(s)) ・Duration: 20 second(s) ・The user becomes unable to activate the [Wish] and [Enhanced Wish] effects.
